messages:
zoe_newhire: Quick onboarding questions — started 2026-06-10. 1) If I enroll in vision now, when does it kick in? 2) I paid $45 for transit this week  does Redwood have a commuter benefit or pre-tax transit? 3) I bought a small desk lamp $28  expense path?

sophie (People Ops): Welcome Zoe! :wave: Vision follows same rule as medical: first of month after 30 days (so 2026-08-01 for your start unless you chose expedited). Commuter: we offer a pre-tax transit benefit via the payroll portal but it needs enrollment before the payroll cutoff; see steps below. Lamp: Ramp category = "Onboarding - Home Office" or Google expense form if you don't have Ramp yet.

zoe_newhire: transit is urgent  how fast can I enroll to get pre-tax this cycle?

mike_payroll: If you enroll in the payroll commuter program before the payroll cutoff (10th for mid-month run and 25th for month-end run), we can start deductions on the next run. Since you started 6/10, enroll ASAP in Rippling > Benefits > Commuter and email payroll to confirm.

alec_finance: For the lamp: receipt, category, date. Example note we accept: 

"Expense: Desk lamp | Amount: $28.00 | Date: 2026-06-11 | Category: Onboarding - Home Office | Notes: One-time new hire workspace item"

alec_finance: Turnaround ~3 business days; reimbursement via payroll. If you need it off-cycle, tag finance with "urgent-offcycle" in Ramp.

hr-bot: Reminder: New hire benefits enrollment due by 2026-06-24. Complete elections in Rippling to avoid default plan selection.

zoe_newhire: thanks! last thing: my bank had a holiday so i'm worried first direct deposit might delay. any pointer?

mike_payroll: Bank holidays can delay posting by one business day. If payroll runs on the 15th/30th and a bank holiday affects posting, you'll see a one-day delay. Pay stubs are still generated on schedule. If there is a longer delay, payroll will notify affected employees.

sophie (People Ops): Ping me if any reimbursements don't show up in two runs and I will escalate. Welcome again! :tada:
